crossRefs.note: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed…
Samaria will bear her guilt; for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be…

translations.web: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
translations.bsb: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
translations.kjv: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
translations.asv: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock. Psalm 138 A Psalm of David.
